impact: A PC maker beating on revenue suggests demand is holding up despite higher memory costs, mildly supportive for memory pricing at MU.
summary: HP Inc's fiscal Q4 EPS of $0.83 beat the roughly $0.75 consensus and revenue of $16.00 billion topped $15.42 billion. It guided fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS to $3.15 to $3.45 versus a $3.17 estimate. Shares rose about 2% after hours but were about 0.8% lower premarket Wednesday.
title: HP Inc Q4 beats at $16.0B revenue, guides FY27 EPS $3.15 to $3.45
